outputs: recommended native, composite, and shape-built chart presets

presets.title: Executive KPI scorecard
presets.powerPointPreset: Medium accent with Header Row, First Column, and Banded Rows
presets.dataShape: metrics with current value, target, and status
useWhen: Summarize KPIs for an operating review, board update, or leadership dashboard.
Use when the table needs to look premium without becoming a chart.
avoidWhen: Avoid for raw exports with more than about ten rows.
presets.fidelityNote: Uses native table geometry plus deterministic cell styling. The tableStyleId/conditional flags mirror PowerPoint Table Design options; the recipe adds reliable premium visual fidelity.

presets.title: Financial variance table
presets.powerPointPreset: Header Row, Total Row, First Column, and Banded Rows
presets.dataShape: numeric rows with subtotal or total row
useWhen: Show plan, actual, and variance in finance, sales, or operations reviews.
Use when a final total row must be visually anchored.
avoidWhen: Avoid when the variance is better shown as a waterfall chart.
presets.fidelityNote: Designed for numbers: right-aligned numeric columns, a strong total row, and subtle banding that survives light backgrounds.

presets.title: Roadmap status lanes
presets.powerPointPreset: Header Row, First Column, Last Column, and Banded Rows
presets.dataShape: workstreams with milestones, dates, owners, and status
useWhen: Track product, GTM, migration, or transformation roadmap status.
Use when names, dates, and accountable owners matter more than a Gantt chart.
avoidWhen: Avoid for precise schedule dependencies; use a timeline or process diagram.
presets.fidelityNote: Optimized for scanning: emphasized workstream and status columns match the First Column and Last Column ribbon options.

presets.title: Feature comparison matrix
presets.powerPointPreset: Header Row, First Column, and Banded Columns
presets.dataShape: features or criteria across products, plans, or options
useWhen: Compare vendors, packages, pricing tiers, or feature coverage.
Use when columns are the primary comparison axis.
avoidWhen: Avoid for long prose; convert to grouped cards or a summary table.
presets.fidelityNote: Banded columns reflect the PowerPoint ribbon variant and improve comparison across tiers.

presets.title: Risk heatmap matrix
presets.powerPointPreset: Header Row and First Column with contextual cell fills
presets.dataShape: matrix with qualitative or scored cells
useWhen: Show risk exposure, maturity, priority, readiness, or coverage by domain.
Use when cell color carries meaning.
avoidWhen: Avoid when exact values need axes and a legend; use a chart.
presets.fidelityNote: Best built as explicit cell fills rather than relying only on a native table style, because the semantic color scale is content-driven.

presets.title: Dark evidence grid
presets.powerPointPreset: Dark accent with Header Row and Banded Rows
presets.tableIntent: evidence grid on a dark slide
presets.dataShape: proof points, claims, sources, or experiment results
useWhen: Place compact proof, benchmarks, or validation evidence on a dark presentation surface.
Use with product, security, AI, or technical narratives.
avoidWhen: Avoid for dense worksheets; dark tables lose readability at small sizes.
presets.fidelityNote: Uses high-contrast fills and restrained borders to avoid muddy dark-slide tables.

presets.title: Clean dense data grid
presets.powerPointPreset: Light grid with Header Row and Banded Rows
presets.dataShape: many rows or columns with short values
useWhen: Render operational data, extracts, audit tables, or appendix material.
Use when legibility matters more than decorative styling.
avoidWhen: Avoid for hero-slide storytelling; use a more expressive preset.
presets.fidelityNote: Closest to a classic PowerPoint light table style while staying deterministic through explicit table and cell options.

presets.title: Pricing tier matrix
presets.powerPointPreset: Header Row, First Column, Last Column, and Banded Columns
presets.dataShape: tier columns with features, limits, and a recommended tier
useWhen: Compare plans, service tiers, or packaging options.
Use when the preferred tier should stand out.
avoidWhen: Avoid when the pricing story needs customer segments or sliders.
presets.fidelityNote: The Last Column ribbon variant and recipe highlight make a recommended tier visible without adding extra shapes.

presets.title: Clustered column
presets.dataShape: categorical comparison with one or more series
useWhen: Compare categories across a small number of series.
Use for quarterly performance, regions, products, or before/after category comparisons.
avoidWhen: Avoid for long category labels; use clustered bar instead.
Avoid for part-to-whole share; use doughnut or pie.
presets.fidelityNote: Native chart XML using barChart with barDir=col and clustered grouping.

presets.title: Stacked column
presets.dataShape: categorical contribution by segment
useWhen: Show absolute contribution of segments within each category.
Use when both totals and component mix matter.
avoidWhen: Avoid when precise segment comparison matters across many categories.
presets.fidelityNote: Native chart XML using stacked column grouping.

presets.title: 100% stacked column
presets.dataShape: normalized categorical contribution by segment
useWhen: Compare mix or share of components across categories.
Use when each category should total to 100%.
avoidWhen: Avoid when absolute totals are important.
presets.fidelityNote: Native chart XML using percentStacked column grouping.

presets.title: 3-D clustered column
presets.dataShape: categorical comparison with 3-D view metadata
useWhen: Use sparingly for presentation-showcase specimens or when the brief explicitly asks for 3-D chart styling.
avoidWhen: Avoid for analytical precision or dense dashboards.
presets.fidelityNote: Native bar3DChart with view3D rotation options.

presets.title: Clustered bar
presets.dataShape: ranked categories or categories with long labels
useWhen: Compare ranked categories.
Use when labels are long or category count is higher than a column chart can comfortably hold.
avoidWhen: Avoid for time series; use line or area.
presets.fidelityNote: Native chart XML using barChart with barDir=bar.

presets.title: Line trend
presets.dataShape: ordered time or sequence series
useWhen: Show trend over time.
Use for rates, revenue, adoption, forecast, or progress across periods.
avoidWhen: Avoid for unrelated nominal categories.
presets.fidelityNote: Native lineChart with workbook-backed series.

presets.title: Line with markers
presets.dataShape: short ordered series where individual points matter
useWhen: Show a trend while emphasizing each measured point.
Use when there are fewer than about 12 periods.
avoidWhen: Avoid when markers create visual clutter.
presets.fidelityNote: Native lineChart with marker options.

presets.title: Stacked area
presets.dataShape: time trend with cumulative contribution
useWhen: Show cumulative volume and changing contribution over time.
Use for capacity, pipeline, or audience mix over periods.
avoidWhen: Avoid for many overlapping series or exact comparisons.
presets.fidelityNote: Native areaChart with stacked grouping.

presets.title: Pie
presets.dataShape: single series part-to-whole share
useWhen: Show a simple part-to-whole split with few categories.
Use when the total is obvious and categories are mutually exclusive.
avoidWhen: Avoid for more than five or six slices; use doughnut, bar, or treemap.
presets.fidelityNote: Native pieChart.

presets.title: Doughnut share
presets.dataShape: single series part-to-whole share with center annotation space
useWhen: Show share while leaving room for a center KPI label.
Use in executive dashboards and compact KPI cards.
avoidWhen: Avoid when exact slice comparison is critical.
presets.fidelityNote: Native doughnutChart with hole size.

presets.title: Scatter correlation
presets.powerPointPreset: Scatter with Straight Lines and Markers
presets.dataShape: numeric x values plus one or more numeric y series
useWhen: Show relationship, correlation, outliers, or measured x/y observations.
avoidWhen: Avoid for categorical x axes; use line or column.
presets.fidelityNote: Native scatterChart. Data expects first series as X values and following series as Y values.

presets.title: Bubble portfolio
presets.dataShape: numeric x/y values plus bubble sizes
useWhen: Compare three numeric dimensions, such as risk, return, and size.
Use for portfolio or market maps.
avoidWhen: Avoid when bubble area would imply false precision.
presets.fidelityNote: Native bubbleChart with sizes arrays.

presets.title: Filled radar capability profile
presets.dataShape: multivariate score profile on shared dimensions
useWhen: Compare capability, maturity, feature coverage, or balanced-scorecard dimensions.
Use for the Radar picker specimen shown in PowerPoint.
avoidWhen: Avoid for unrelated metrics with different scales.
presets.fidelityNote: Native radarChart with radarStyle=filled.

presets.title: Column plus line combo
presets.powerPointPreset: Clustered Column - Line on Secondary Axis
presets.dataShape: two measures with different units or scales over the same categories
useWhen: Combine volume and rate, revenue and margin, or actual and target on one plot.
Best default for executive chart dashboards.
avoidWhen: Avoid when the second axis would confuse the story.
presets.fidelityNote: Native multi-type chart using bar and line chart definitions in one plot area.

presets.title: Treemap hierarchy
presets.dataShape: hierarchical part-to-whole values
useWhen: Show hierarchical contribution or portfolio composition.
Use as the best native new-authoring choice for nested part-to-whole values.
